description:
World first 32er MTB
After the Gravel 32er revolution, the MTB 32er bike is now bringing the big wheel benefits to mountain biking.
The new DirtySixer MTB 32er hardtail is the world's first trail bike designed and fabricated to use the full potential of the big 32" wheels for the most gnarly singletracks. From Trail, to AllMountain and even Enduro, the new 32er MTB DirtySixer bike introduces an unprecedented level of control, floatation, speed and smoothness.Riders who used to enjoy the advantage of the 29er wheels over 26 or 27.5 will discover a new world of efficiency.
Created around a lightweight, durable 6061 alloy frame and an inverted 140mm suspension fork, the new 32er MTB DirtySixer bike is hand fabricated with the highest level of care and ready for anything you'll throw at it. Tall riders will be amazed at the stability on rough descents, that used to be full suspension bike's territory.
Climbing capacity is also improved thanks to the longer wheelbase and the riders' center of gravity placed inside the bike instead of over the rear axle. Thanks to more than a decade of experience building big 36er bikes for NBA players, the MTB 32er geometry follows the tradition of perfectly engineered dynamics for bigger, taller and sometimes heavier riders. All that while maintaining a fun and responsive handling to carve the most fun lines on the trails. Practicality isn't forgotten, with UDH drop outs, internal routing for dropper seatpost and plenty of eyelets for attaching framebag, water bottles or light rear rack in case the Continental Divide is on your list of challenges.
The DirtySixer MTB 32er will open new horizons to riders that used to feel cramped on their 29er or want to be the first ones to take full advantage of the bigger wheel size!
Delivery March 2026.
PS: Note that all technical information and component's list are subject to change without prior notice.
Sizing chart:
Advantages of a 32-inch wheel MTB bike:
1. Enhanced Rolling Efficiency
Better Momentum: Larger wheels maintain momentum better, making it easier to roll over obstacles like rocks, roots, and rough terrain with less effort.
Smoother Ride: The larger diameter helps to smooth out bumps, providing a more comfortable ride on uneven surfaces.
2. Improved Stability
Greater Contact Patch: A 32-inch wheel has a larger contact patch with the ground, which enhances traction, stability, especially at higher speeds and on loose surfaces.
More Predictable Handling: The increased wheel size can make the bike more stable and predictable, which is particularly beneficial for rough trails and at high speeds.
3. Better Traction
Increased Grip: The larger wheels can offer better traction on dirt trails, sand or snow, thanks to our wide 2.40" tires.
Reduced Slippage: The enhanced contact patch reduces the likelihood of breaking traction on loose or wet surfaces.
4. Obstacle Clearance
Easier to Roll Over Obstacles: Larger wheels can roll over larger obstacles more easily, reducing the need to slow down or maneuver around them, thanks to the lower angle of attack.
Less Jarring Impact: The ability to absorb impacts with the bigger air volume makes for a less jarring and more controllable ride.
5. More Efficient Over Long Distances
Reduced Fatigue: The smoother ride and better momentum thanks to the lower angle of attack make it easier to cover long distances with less fatigue.
Improved Performance: For long trail rides, the better roll-over of 32-inch wheels will lead to better efficiency and a more comfortable experience.
6. Aesthetics and Unique Appeal
Distinctive Look: The MTB 32er offers a unique and proportionate look that sets it apart from 29er XL and XXL bikes.
Innovation Appeal: For riders interested in cutting-edge and innovative bike designs, the 32er MTB bike brings a real revolution to trail riding efficiency.
